method: The research container could not open the site itself (outbound fetches are refused), so the features come from web-search results of the site's own pages (listed in sources) and from how the product is publicly known to work; a feature not confirmed by a search result says so in its detail. Verse's side was read from this repository's source.

features.name: Common converters
features.detail: length, temperature, area, volume, weight, time
features.verse_evidence: convert/index.html Kind select: Length, Weight and mass, Temperature, Volume, Area, Time

features.name: Speed, pressure, energy, power, force, angle, fuel consumption, data storage
Many units per kind
features.detail: long unit lists per converter (e.g. length has dozens incl. historic units)
features.verse_evidence: length has 15 units (convert/index.html select); fewer obscure units

features.name: Engineering converters

features.verse_evidence: none of these kinds in lib/units.js KINDS

features.name: Heat converters

features.name: Fluids converters

features.name: Light converters
features.detail: illuminance plus luminance, luminous intensity, digital image resolution, frequency to wavelength

features.name: Electricity converters
features.detail: charge plus current, voltage (electric potential), resistance, resistivity, conductance, capacitance, inductance, field strength, charge densities

features.name: Magnetism converters

features.name: Radiology converters
